name: @chaoticgoodcomputing/icons
description: Icon ids drawn for Quartz 5 plugins: `prefix:name` to inline SVG in currentColor, at build time, from installed Iconify sets (MDI) and a site's own SVG files. See CONTEXT.md.
//exports: Source only: no build and no dist. The consuming plugin's build inlines it (ADR-0005). Server-side: it reads the file system.
//dependencies: Iconify's packages, which run while the site builds. They can't all be inlined (svgo, under @iconify/tools, reads its data files at run time), so a consuming plugin keeps them external and carries each as its own dependency, at exactly these versions (docs/adr/0001). Pinned exactly for that reason. MDI is a package, pinned by the lockfile, never a fetch.
//devDependencies: Types only: @iconify/types is erased at build.
